observations: Bruijns et al., Nature Neuroscience 2026 use a dynamic infinite hidden semi-Markov model for mouse learning. The semi-Markov component explicitly allows non-geometric state durations, while the model also separates abrupt state changes from slower within-state evolution. Across 134 mice and >1.9 million trials, learning was described by a small number of recurring behavioral stages whose durations varied substantially across animals. The authors explicitly note that duration distributions may themselves need to change over training, which is directly relevant to duration-prior brittleness under nonstationarity.

Godin and Thivierge, PLOS Computational Biology, published 2026-08-25, formally present SPLiT as online empirical-manifold tracking plus supervised learning in manifold coordinates and provide S1 Code as a ZIP. A fresh read-only public-source attempt again confirmed the S1 Code link but did not yield file-level source contents through the available transport.

bounded_audit.status: explicit_duration_helps_when_duration_semantics_hold_but_fails_under_duration_semantic_shift; online model averaging recovers most of the loss; utility_gate_not_main_bottleneck; non-reproduction

design.purpose: Test the exact next-action hypothesis from the prior clean checkpoint: whether explicit-duration cause models improve temporary-silence versus persistent-change inference, and whether their value survives altered duration/hazard regimes. This is a bounded source-derived engineering control, not a reproduction of SPLiT or Bruijns et al.
design.event_model: Synthetic event-level cause stream with two ambiguous causes: temporary latent silence S and persistent context change C. Both emit five correlated local change features. Calibration duration medians were approximately 32 steps for S and 12 for C. A disjoint held-out duration-swap regime reversed those semantics. Additional hazard-shift and emission-overlap families were evaluated.
design.calibration: 18 disjoint calibration seeds fit class-conditional Gaussian emissions and smoothed empirical duration distributions. 16 additional calibration-validation seeds selected only a bounded duration log-likelihood-ratio cap; no held-out test family was used for fitting.
design.decision_point: Cause posterior evaluated at up to 12 event steps. Emission-only posterior was compared with explicit empirical-duration evidence and a capped-duration variant. This is an episode-level semi-Markov duration-likelihood surrogate, not a full online HSMM filter.
design.dynamic_shift: 400-event streams switched from matched duration semantics for the first 200 events to reversed duration semantics for the final 200. An exponentially weighted two-expert mixture between emission-only and explicit-duration posteriors was updated only when delayed/sparse cause labels arrived. Moderate feedback used 50% labels delayed 8 events; severe feedback used 25% labels delayed 16 events.
design.utility_control: A separate synthetic cost-sensitive dormant-memory proxy estimated benefit and stale-interference cost from disjoint calibration data. A conservative risk-aware admission threshold used the 20th percentile calibrated silence benefit, 80th percentile persistent-change cost, a memory carrying cost and positive margin. This tests whether utility-aware admission itself is the missing mechanism; it is not a biological claim.

matched.interpretation: duration evidence materially improves calibrated cause inference when calibration duration semantics remain valid

emission_overlap.interpretation: duration evidence is most useful when local emission evidence is ambiguous

duration_swap.interpretation: reversing silence/change duration semantics makes a fixed explicit-duration prior catastrophically misleading; clipping reduces but does not remove the failure

duration_and_hazard_shift.interpretation: duration-prior shift dominates the benefit even when a bounded likelihood-ratio cap is used

interpretation: The adaptive mixture preserves most of the matched-regime duration benefit, then strongly downweights explicit duration evidence after semantics reverse.
With delayed/sparse supervision it does not fully match an oracle that knows to ignore duration immediately after the shift; residual late-post-shift Brier remains slightly above emission-only.
This supports uncertainty-aware model averaging over hard duration commitment. It does not establish that this particular Hedge rule is biologically special or optimal.

Cost-sensitive admission did not solve posterior misspecification: when duration semantics reversed, the adaptive posterior recovered substantial utility relative to fixed explicit duration but still lagged the emission-only oracle.

A calibrated utility threshold was close to a simple 0.65 posterior threshold and produced only tiny incremental differences. The dominant bottleneck is therefore cause-posterior robustness, not the final scalar admission threshold in this bounded control.

candidate_update.positive_scope: When temporary-silence and persistent-change duration semantics are stable, explicit duration information substantially improves ambiguous cause inference. Delayed/sparse supervised model averaging can learn to downweight a now-wrong duration expert after a semantic reversal and recover most of the lost Brier/utility.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: A fixed explicit-duration prior can become much worse than emission-only inference when duration semantics reverse. Simple likelihood clipping is insufficient, and cost-sensitive dormant-memory admission cannot rescue a misspecified cause posterior.

limits: Synthetic event-level control only; not a source-exact SPLiT simulation and not a reproduction of the Nature Neuroscience diHSMM.
Event onset/offset handling is simplified; the explicit-duration term is an episode-level semi-Markov surrogate rather than a full latent-state filter.
The adaptive mixture receives delayed/sparse synthetic cause labels; fully unsupervised duration-trust adaptation remains untested.
Utility values are synthetic bounded task-loss proxies, used only to test whether a cost-sensitive final gate can compensate for posterior misspecification.
Duration distributions were deliberately reversed in held-out shift conditions to stress semantic nonstationarity.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace the episode-level surrogate with a full online explicit-duration latent-state filter that maintains separate temporary-silence and persistent-change sojourn models. Add uncertainty-aware duration trust rather than a hard duration prior: compare (a) emission-only, (b) fixed HSMM, (c) capped duration Bayes factor, (d) delayed/sparse-label adaptive expert mixing, and (e) an unsupervised duration-shift detector using predictive duration likelihood or posterior predictive checks. Fit all duration/emission/hazard parameters on disjoint calibration streams and lock them before held-out matched, hazard-shift, duration-swap and mixed-nonstationary streams. Integrate the posterior into the existing PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like dormant-memory task simulation so utility is measured by actual post-silence recovery and post-switch interference rather than synthetic scalar proxies. Preserve calibration/Brier/ECE, detection latency, false/true admission, post-silence recovery, post-switch interference, delayed/sparse feedback, exact tested scope and a nonempty frontier.
